title: Sanitary Tee vs Wye in Horizontal Drains
description: Using a sanitary tee on a horizontal drainage run is one of the most frequent installation mistakes in residential plumbing. Sanitary tees have a short sweep designed primarily for vertical-to-horizontal transitions. When installed horizontally, waste solids hit the back wall of the fitting, causing turbulence, solids separation, and eventual blockages. To maintain flow velocity and direct wastewater smoothly along horizontal runs, always install a wye with a 1/8 bend or a combination wye fitting. Always verify fitting allowances against your local plumbing code before installation.
